intro.heading: What Is Included on a Uniworld River Cruise?
intro.leadCard: Planning a luxury river cruise often starts with one important question: what exactly is included in the fare? Unlike many ocean cruises where additional charges can quickly add up, Uniworld Boutique River Cruises is known for offering one of the industry's most comprehensive all-inclusive experiences.
paragraphs: From elegant accommodations and gourmet dining to premium beverages, immersive shore excursions, airport transfers on select sailings, gratuities, and personalized service, many of the costs travelers typically budget separately are already included.
This guide explains everything you can expect to receive when booking a Uniworld River Cruise, helping you understand the overall value before you travel.

ratings.description: Boutique, museum-quality handcrafted staterooms and suites.
Farm-to-table gourmet culinary programs and unlimited premium beverages.
Curated daily guided shore excursions in every port of call.
Attentive, personalized hospitality with all onboard gratuities prepaid.
Fitness centers, wellness classes, bicycles, and entertainment.
Comprehensive all-inclusive pricing eliminating hidden vacation expenses.

quickAnswer.title: Quick Answer: What Is Included in a Uniworld River Cruise?
quickAnswer.lead: A Uniworld River Cruise fare includes luxury boutique accommodations, all gourmet meals, unlimited premium wines, spirits, and beers, daily guided shore excursions, onboard gratuities, complimentary Wi-Fi, fitness facilities, entertainment, and scheduled airport transfers on select itineraries.
quickAnswer.subtext: Guests can travel with complete peace of mind knowing that nearly all vacation expenses are covered upfront in one transparent fare.

whatMakesDifferent.title: Why Uniworld Offers One of the Most Inclusive River Cruise Experiences
whatMakesDifferent.lead: Uniworld positions itself as a luxury boutique river cruise company where guests enjoy an experience that feels similar to staying in an upscale five-star hotel. Instead of charging separately for common amenities, the cruise fare typically includes:
items: Premium wines, beer, cocktails, and spirits
Scheduled airport transfers on eligible itineraries
whatMakesDifferent.footerNote: This approach simplifies travel planning and allows guests to enjoy their vacation without constantly considering additional costs.

accommodations.title: Elegant Boutique Accommodations
accommodations.lead: Every stateroom and suite includes thoughtfully designed interiors inspired by the destinations visited.
accommodations.footnote: Many ships feature individually designed rooms rather than identical cabin layouts, giving each vessel a boutique hotel atmosphere.

dining.title: Gourmet Dining Included Every Day
dining.intro: Dining is one of Uniworld's signature experiences. Enjoy destination-inspired menus crafted by master chefs using fresh, locally sourced ingredients.

beverages.title: Unlimited Premium Beverages
beverages.lead: Unlike many cruise lines that sell beverage packages separately, Uniworld includes premium drinks throughout much of the voyage.
beverages.footnote: Wine is carefully selected to complement each region visited.

excursions.lead: One of the biggest values included in the cruise fare is a wide selection of guided excursions.

excursions.footnote: Many itineraries also offer multiple excursion choices each day, allowing travelers to select activities matching their interests and activity level.

butlerServices.lead: Luxury hospitality is one of Uniworld's defining characteristics.
butlerServices.footnote: Guests throughout the ship also benefit from an exceptionally high crew-to-guest ratio, providing attentive and personalized service.

wellness.banner: Some newer ships also feature pools or wellness-focused facilities.

comparison.footnote: Uniworld consistently ranks among the most inclusive luxury river cruise operators due to the breadth of services bundled into the cruise fare.

value.title: Why Many Travelers Find Uniworld Good Value
value.lead: Although Uniworld cruises often carry a higher upfront price than some competitors, many travelers appreciate knowing that most vacation expenses have already been covered.
value.desc: By bundling everything into one transparent fare, Uniworld eliminates the "nickel-and-diming" typical of other cruise lines. This allows you to relax fully without worrying about calculations at every meal, drink, or excursion.
value.quote: For travelers seeking a hassle-free luxury vacation, the comprehensive fare often represents strong overall value.

expertInsight.title: Insight from Angela Hughes
expertInsight.quote: Uniworld's all-inclusive model removes the anxiety of onboard spending entirely. When your drinks, excursions, and gratuities are covered, you're free to simply be present — and that's priceless.
expertInsight.bio: As founder of Luxury Travel University and CEO of Trips & Ships Luxury Travel, Angela Hughes uses her personal, deep connections in the river cruising world to deliver custom travel planning that regular booking engines simply cannot replicate.

faqs.question: What is included on a Uniworld River Cruise?
faqs.answer: The fare typically includes accommodations, meals, premium beverages, excursions, Wi-Fi, gratuities, entertainment, and selected transfers.

faqs.question: Are alcoholic drinks included with Uniworld?
faqs.answer: Yes. Premium wines, beer, spirits, cocktails, and many non-alcoholic beverages are generally included.

faqs.question: Are shore excursions included?
faqs.answer: Yes. Most daily guided excursions are included in the cruise fare.

faqs.question: Does Uniworld include gratuities?
faqs.answer: Yes. Onboard gratuities for the crew are generally included.

faqs.question: Is Wi-Fi free on Uniworld ships?
faqs.answer: Yes. Complimentary Wi-Fi is available on most vessels.

faqs.question: Are airport transfers included?
faqs.answer: Many itineraries include airport transfers when eligibility requirements are met.

faqs.question: Does Uniworld include specialty dining?
faqs.answer: Many itineraries feature specialty dining experiences and destination-inspired meals at no extra charge.

faqs.question: Is butler service included?
faqs.answer: Butler service is included with selected suite categories.

faqs.question: Are fitness facilities included?
faqs.answer: Yes. Guests can use onboard fitness centers and participate in many wellness activities.

faqs.question: Are spa treatments included?
faqs.answer: No. Spa treatments and massages usually incur an additional fee.

faqs.question: Can dietary requirements be accommodated?
faqs.answer: Yes. Vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, and other dietary requests can typically be accommodated with advance notice.

faqs.question: Are bicycles available onboard?
faqs.answer: Many Uniworld ships provide complimentary bicycles for guided or independent rides.

faqs.question: Is room service included?
faqs.answer: Room service is available on many ships, with expanded options for suite guests.

faqs.question: Does every itinerary include the same amenities?
faqs.answer: Core inclusions remain similar, but some services vary by ship, destination, and itinerary.

faqs.question: Is Uniworld truly all-inclusive?
faqs.answer: Uniworld is considered one of the most inclusive luxury river cruise lines, although expenses such as airfare, spa treatments, travel insurance, and personal purchases are generally not included.
